properties.Zombie: Swap the clean head for a gaunt painted zombie head; original facial controls remain active.
properties.FaceBlood: Optional painted dried blood at the mouth corner.
properties.BodyDirt: Optional painted dirt on the jacket front.
properties.TornSleeve: Swap the clean jacket for its prepared left-sleeve hole variant.
properties.DetachWristL: Replace the left hand with a matching capped separation variant.
properties.WristSeparation: Translate the detached hand/nails/cap away from the wrist. Requires DetachWristL=1.

default: All switches and separation amount are zero; clean character is visible.
clean_object_changes: Only hide_viewport/hide_render visibility drivers for variant swaps.
limits: Prepared alternate wrist/hand only; other body cut zones are not created.
Detached hand retains its original finger/hand rig deformation and adds an object offset; independent free-fall animation needs baking or a dedicated prop rig.
Matching wrist caps sit under the retained fleece cuff and require a shot-specific camera check.
Decals follow copied expression keys and body weights; transparent patches need render verification.
Torn sleeve is a prepared polygon hole and flat lining, not cloth simulation or exposed anatomy.
Unused mesh vertices are intentionally retained on patches to preserve all deformation indices.
background_self_check: PASS: zero/enabled/reset visibility, gaunt key, hand offset, finite evaluated vertices; no blend saved.
